description.short: Read Copilot balances, spending policies and policy group users as the caller.
description.full: Experimental read-only plugin with an integrated credit-management skill and an OAuth-protected Azure MCP connector. Five tools read tenant balances, spending policies, policy-assigned groups, group users and per-user service balances through delegated Microsoft Graph access. The cost-management API is Preview/beta. Roster reads require Assignment and GroupMember.ReadBasic administrator consent in addition to UserData. Membership includes nested users by default and may lag recent changes; it does not prove policy enforcement. Missing quantities remain unavailable and incomplete pagination is explicit. No write operations. Actual roster availability and authorized access must be tested in Cowork.

agentConnectors.description: Read tenant/user balances, spending policies, assigned groups and group users as the signed-in caller. Policy roster requires delegated Assignment and GroupMember.ReadBasic consent; user balances require UserData. Experimental and read-only.
